headings.name: Cinzel
headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings. Adds the 'Sacred Manuscript' feel.

body.name: Lato
body.usage: Use for Bible text, UI labels, and long-form reading. High legibility.

accent.name: Cormorant Garamond
accent.usage: Use for verse numbers, pull quotes, and section introductions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio of 4.5:1. Use Text Shadow on dark backgrounds for legibility.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling glow pulses.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Use the provided color palette. Implement a theme provider that switches between 'Illuminated Manuscript' (Light) and 'Bioluminescent Sanctuary' (Dark).
2. TYPOGRAPHY: Load 'Cinzel' and 'Lato' fonts immediately. Apply 'Cinzel' to all headers.
3. BIBLE READER: The reader view must be immersive. Hide UI elements on scroll. Use the 'parchment' texture for the background in Light mode.
4. ANIMATIONS: Use Reanimated or Framer Motion for the 'Glow' effect on selected verses. When a user taps a verse, it should gently illuminate.
5. PATHS: The 'My Paths' feature should visually look like a constellation or a journey map, not just a list.
6. WIDGETS: The Daily Verse widget must use the 'glow_md' shadow and have a subtle border gradient.
7. TECH STACK: You are in an Expo Web environment. Use Tailwind classes (className) compatible with NativeWind or React Native Web.
8. IMAGES: Use the provided texture URLs as background images via CSS 'background-image'. Set background-size to cover.
9. DATA TEST ID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'SaaS' look. No flat blue buttons.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards.
Never use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds; use the provided #02040A.
Interactive elements must provide immediate visual feedback (glow or scale).
